Buy a rice cooker. Buy frozen vegetables (the microwave in bag variety). Buy some chicken.
Make some rice (preferably brown), microwave a bag of vegies and pan fry some chicken. Easy to make and fairly nutritious.

Some of this is going to come down to your individual biology. Whereas food sensitivity is largely overblown (particularly with regards to MSG and gluten) you will respond better to some foods rather than others.

Buy rice and pasta in bulk because it doesn't spoil and is quick and easy to cook.

Also buy a big container of bread crumbs for around $2. You can make easy chicken cutlets this way. A very easy meal for a single guy to make is to pre-heat the oven to 400, coat a chicken cutlet in bread crumbs and throw it in the oven for 22 minutes. There is almost nothing to clean up after making this simple but tasty meal. Good luck to you.

BOLOGNA SANDWHICHES

Buy a loaf of bread for around $1, a pack of bologna for around $2-$3, a bag of spinach or lettuce for around $3 and condiments of your choice (I like yellow mustard)

Bologna sandwhiches are extremely cheap, easy to prepair, and have protein from the meat, carbs from the bread, and vitamines from the spinach/lettuce.

CEREAL
